$ rhythm-roadie config init --stack wordpress
Wrote .roadie/config.yaml for a WordPress site.
Set source:, target: and url: in it, then run rhythm-roadie plan.
Added .roadie/reports, .roadie/key and .roadie/backups to .git/info/exclude.
--- .roadie/config.yaml
# Roadie settings.

source: ""            # where production is
target: ""
url: ""
stack: wordpress

columns: []
#  - table: wp_loyalty_members
